assumptions.statement: Submitted site and three key-area polygons are participant provisional constraints, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All siting, geometry and three formal core metrics are temporary design-model values; replace and recompute after official geometry.

assumptions.statement: Only publicly traceable Jing-Zhang history cues are eligible; archive IDs, relic lists, dates and image rights have not been fully verified in this package.
assumptions.impact: A curator must verify each historical claim against a first-hand record before publication; unverified claims stay labelled as leads.

assumptions.statement: Six international pages are traceable public mechanism references; none establishes local partnership, performance, funding or endorsement.
assumptions.impact: Use only for mechanism comparison and keep local transfer, scale and outcome claims out of the package.

assumptions.statement: Park, building, station-edge, wall, kiosk and operating rights are unknown.
assumptions.impact: Do not site or install; run title, heritage, safety, accessibility and operator checks before any pilot.

assumptions.statement: Statutory land use, FAR, height, density, road/rail line, blue-green line, heritage control, underground and municipal capacity are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Keep controls as null or directional; professional teams must recalculate and approve any later detailed design.

assumptions.statement: Current visitor demand, archive count, accessibility, staffing, budget, travel time and service workload are not provided.
assumptions.impact: Establish a small, consented baseline before testing; never present target bands as existing performance.

assumptions.statement: Historical photos, footage, oral histories, voices, fonts, marks and metadata have distinct rights and consent states.
assumptions.impact: Use only public-domain, cleared, or explicitly consented material; withdraw and suppress any item whose rights or consent is uncertain.

assumptions.statement: Oral history may contain personal, sensitive or third-party information and must not be assumed public or trainable.
assumptions.impact: Use consented, de-identified or synthetic test inputs; delete or quarantine revoked records and prohibit individual profiling.

assumptions.statement: Model choice, accuracy, drift, language coverage and deployment security are not validated here.
assumptions.impact: Use shadow tests with human review, publish only approved outputs, and stop the card when evaluation, data quality or audit conditions fail.

assumptions.statement: Government, archive, community, university, enterprise and operator roles are proposed role types, not appointed entities.
assumptions.impact: Use the RACI as a handoff template; no participation, funding, event, procurement or policy commitment is claimed.

assumptions.statement: The names JZMA, Archive Gallery and all marks are internal concept codenames; prior rights and conflicts are not cleared.
assumptions.impact: Run trademark, domain, font and partner-mark checks before public use; replace the mark if conflict appears.
